About this item

  • Designed for Productivity — Compatible for MacBook & Most USB-C Laptops: Built to expand your MacBook's USB-C ports, this 8-in-1 hub delivers essential connections for office, home, business travel, online classes and video conferencing. Fully compatible for MacBook Pro/Air, Dell XPS, HP, Lenovo and more USB-C laptops.
  • 4K HDMI for Crisp Work & Entertainment Displays: Enjoy stunning 4K@60Hz output when connecting to external monitors, TVs or projectors—ideal for multitasking, presentations, working from home or immersive streaming. Stable signal transmission ensures smooth, detailed visuals every time.
  • High-Speed Wired Internet — Reliable 1Gbps Ethernet: Upgrade your laptop with fast and secure 1Gbps Ethernet, ensuring smoother video calls, lag-free online meetings, stable remote work and reliable large-file downloads—perfect for office or home networking environments.
  • 100W PD Charging + Multi-Port USB Expansion: Pass-through USB-C charging supports up to 100W, powering your laptop while using all ports simultaneously. Includes three USB-A 3.0 ports for keyboards, mice, flash drives and hard drives—boosting your daily productivity.
  • SD & TF Card Readers for Creators and Daily Transfers: Easily transfer photos, videos and documents using built-in SD and microSD card slots. Perfect for photographers, designers, students, teachers and professionals who need convenient, on-the-go media access.

  • 4K HDMI for Crisp Work & Entertainment Displays: Enjoy stunning 4K@60Hz output when connecting to external monitors, TVs or projectors—ideal for multitasking, presentations, working from home or immersive streaming. Stable signal transmission ensures smooth, detailed visuals every time.
